description: This file defines a Flutter widget called `HealthCheck` used for testing connectivity to a Supabase database. It performs read operations on a 'profiles' table and checks user authentication status, providing visual feedback and guidance within the app.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a UI for performing health checks on the Supabase backend.

classes.name: _HealthCheckState
classes.description: State class for the HealthCheck widget, managing the connectivity check logic and UI updates.

methods.name: _runCheck
methods.description: Performs connectivity tests by reading from a database table and checking user authentication, updating the widget state based on results.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the health check screen, including status indicators and a button to trigger checks.

methods.name: _host
methods.description: Getter that extracts and displays the host part of the Supabase URL.
